clips.name: hang_idle
clips.description: Default loop: hangs by its tail, gentle pendulum swing, dangling arms, floppy ears, blink.

clips.name: hang_swing_big
clips.description: Big happy swings with a giggle.

clips.name: hang_wave
clips.description: Waves one hand at the viewer, then winks.

clips.name: hang_eat_banana
clips.description: Peels and nibbles a banana while hanging, cheeks puffing as it chews.

clips.name: hang_to_sit
clips.description: Plays once: flips down off the branch and lands sitting with a squash.

clips.name: sit_to_hang
clips.description: Plays once: jumps up, tail catches the branch, swings into hang_idle.

clips.name: idle_breathe
clips.description: Slow squash-and-stretch breathing, blink, tail curl swish.

clips.name: idle_scratch_head
clips.description: Scratches its head with a puzzled face and a small "?".

clips.name: idle_look_left_right
clips.description: Glances left, then right.

clips.name: idle_yawn
clips.description: Big yawn with squinting eyes.

clips.name: idle_stretch
clips.description: Arms up overhead, tail straight up.

clips.name: idle_groom
clips.description: Picks at its fur, finds something, shrugs.

clips.name: sleep_fall_asleep
clips.description: Plays once: nods off while hanging and wraps its arms around itself.

clips.name: sleep_loop
clips.description: Sleeps hanging: slow breathing, gentle sway, rising z z z, snot bubble.

clips.name: sleep_wake_up
clips.description: Plays once: bubble pops, startled blink, nearly slips, catches itself, shakes its head.

clips.name: move_walk
clips.description: Knuckle-waddle in place, bobbing side to side (the app moves the window).

clips.name: move_hop
clips.description: Excited jump with arms up.

clips.name: move_swing_across
clips.description: Swings along the branch to the right with arms and tail, then loops back into place.

clips.name: move_fall_land
clips.description: Plays once: drops in from above flailing, lands on its bottom with a squash, dizzy stars.

clips.name: int_dragged
clips.description: Held by the tail: dangling and spinning slowly, surprised face, arms flailing.

clips.name: int_petted
clips.description: Happy ^ ^ eyes, leans into the hand, hearts pop up.

clips.name: int_poked
clips.description: Puffed cheeks, crossed arms, annoyed brows, tail flicking, anger mark.

clips.name: int_tickled
clips.description: Wriggles and laughs, eyes squeezed shut, legs kicking.

clips.name: int_look_up
clips.description: Eyes held looking up (cursor following); same timing as hang_idle so clips can be swapped frame-synced.

clips.name: int_look_up_right
clips.description: Eyes held looking up-right (cursor following); same timing as hang_idle so clips can be swapped frame-synced.

clips.name: int_look_right
clips.description: Eyes held looking right (cursor following); same timing as hang_idle so clips can be swapped frame-synced.

clips.name: int_look_down_right
clips.description: Eyes held looking down-right (cursor following); same timing as hang_idle so clips can be swapped frame-synced.

clips.name: int_look_down
clips.description: Eyes held looking down (cursor following); same timing as hang_idle so clips can be swapped frame-synced.

clips.name: int_look_down_left
clips.description: Eyes held looking down-left (cursor following); same timing as hang_idle so clips can be swapped frame-synced.

clips.name: int_look_left
clips.description: Eyes held looking left (cursor following); same timing as hang_idle so clips can be swapped frame-synced.

clips.name: int_look_up_left
clips.description: Eyes held looking up-left (cursor following); same timing as hang_idle so clips can be swapped frame-synced.

clips.name: mood_happy
clips.description: Claps its hands and bounces, sparkles.

clips.name: mood_sad
clips.description: Droopy ears and tail, teardrop, hugs its tail.

clips.name: mood_surprised
clips.description: Jumps, ears up, big round eyes, "!" mark.

clips.name: mood_hungry
clips.description: Rubs its belly, thought bubble with a banana bunch.

clips.name: mood_love
clips.description: Heart eyes, holds a heart, floating hearts.

clips.name: mood_angry
clips.description: Stomps and bares a toothy pout, with steam puffs.

clips.name: mood_laugh
clips.description: Holds its belly and laughs, tears of joy.

clips.name: mood_confused
clips.description: Head tilt, swirly eyes, "?" marks.

clips.name: fun_spin
clips.description: Cartwheel spin.

clips.name: fun_peek
clips.description: Hangs down from the top edge, peeks in upside down, then pulls back up.

clips.name: fun_notify
clips.description: Hangs and waves a banana like a flag under a round yellow "!" badge.

clips.name: fun_banana_juggle
clips.description: Juggles three bananas, then catches them.
